summary: The predicted manipulation plan contains multiple physical impossibilities: interpenetration during pre‑grasp, insufficient grasp force leading to slipping, levitation without support violating gravity and momentum conservation, and loss of object visibility breaking permanence. All stages exhibit violations, resulting in a FAIL verdict.
